label: Xin chào

starting_pose.value: both hands low at lower torso, relaxed/overlapping before lift

ending_pose.value: both hands lower from signing space toward relaxed lower-torso recovery

active_handshape.value: both hands open; five digits extended and visibly spread; thumbs abducted

finger_openness.value: open/spread with natural joint flex; no closed fist or body contact

palm_orientation.value: generally toward camera/front during raised interval

wrist_orientation.value: alternating bilateral side tilt/oscillation while palms remain broadly forward

upper_arm_elbow.value: bilateral shoulder abduction and elbow flexion raise hands to shoulder/face height

hand_location.value: bilateral signing space lateral to upper chest and shoulders

motion_path.value: low center/lower torso -> outward and upward -> localized repeated wrist/hand oscillation -> downward recovery

motion_direction.value: bilateral outward/upward entry, symmetric localized alternating tilt, then downward exit

speed_pattern.value: quick lift, approximately even oscillation, slower recovery

repetition.value: at least two clear alternating wrist/hand tilts; exact linguistic cycle count is ambiguous

head_movement.value: head remains broadly upright; small natural performance motion only

eye_gaze.value: toward camera/viewer for most of the sign

facial_expression.value: friendly smile and speech-like mouth articulation are visible; lexical/grammatical NMM role is unknown

uncertainties: Single frontal camera does not establish exact depth or local Euler wrist/arm rotations.
Motion blur prevents exact finger joint angles at the fastest oscillation frames.
Exact linguistic repetition count needs qualified reviewer confirmation.
Visible smile/mouth movement may be presentation or spoken Vietnamese rather than required NMM.
Neutral entry/recovery are video presentation transitions, not claimed as part of the lexical sign.
